blocks.text: SOP: RF gun login, battery, and location confirm

This is the working cut for PCF-SOP-2024-041 on April 18, 2024. Lila Voss asked for a written bound after the current path (Guns in a pile, logins leftover, 20 percent start common) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Order Picker, writing for Marcus Hale, Tasha Quinn, and Ben Crowe. Primary host rf.pinecrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on share logins when a gun is dead, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Checkout by serial. Login is yours. Dead battery swap at the cage, do not pull a gun off a charger at 20 percent and start a wave. I am not restating a hallway yes. share logins when a gun is dead is out because March 29 shared login put 9 shorts on Marcus's ID. He was on lunch. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: guns=40, shorts=9, pct=30, leftover=1, weeks=2, serial=1, lunch=1, pile=1. Sibling tickets PCF-1680 and PCF-SOP-2024-088. I will not reopen share logins when a gun is dead in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Tasha Quinn is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Ben Crowe owns a leftover that is easy to skip: cage.pinecrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (10): refuse on share logins when a gun is dead, lock is serial checkout, own login, swap under 30 percent. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on PCF-1680.
A gun with someone else's login will pick onto their rate and their errors.

What a skeptical lead would try first on rf.pinecrest.internal: the path Lila Voss actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on wms.pinecrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
Constraints and the lock
